rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING AND PENALIZING THE CRIME OF HOAX KIDNAPPING
rows.abstract:
Defines “Hoax Kidnapping“ as the faking, orchestrating or staging by a person of his/her kidnapping and detention for the purpose of extorting ransom from that person´s family or other entities, or coercing the latter to do or not to do an act.
Proposes that any person who is found guilty of hoax kidnapping shall suffer the penalty of prision correctional and a fine of one hundred thousand pesos (P100,000.00) to one million pesos (P1,000.000.00).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2021-08-02

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TOTAL BAN ON THE IMPORTATION OF WASTES, PROVIDING MEANS FOR ITS ENFORCEMENT, APPROPRIATIONS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Proposes to establish a total ban on the importation of wastes, processed wastes, and its by-products (for whatever purpose, in any form, and in whatever amount) to prevent future incidents of shipments from abroad and therefore send a message internationally that the Philippines is not a dumping site for their wastes.

Provides for the application of relevant penal provisions of environmental and customs laws to violators of this Act, such as but not limited to Ecological Solid Waste Management; Philippine Clean Air Act; Philippine Clean Water Act; Toxic Substances and Hazardous and Nuclear Wastes Control Act; and the Customs Modernization and Tariff Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECOLOGY since 2021-08-02

rows.author: I085
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE INSTALLATION OF ALTERNATIVE PAYMENT SYSTEMS IN ALL PUBLIC OFFICES AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Intends to reduce face-to-face government transactions by mandating the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) to develop an electronic payment system which shall be readily available for use by all government agencies and instrumentalities, which shall be accessible to all Filipinos.
Provides that the payment system shall include, but is not limited to, the use of debit cards, credit cards, online banking, e-money, and mobile wallets; encourages partnerships with reputable  banks and financial institutions regulated by the BSP; and assures that any data collected, processed and stored through this Act shall be secured and protected under the Data Privacy Act (R.A. No. 10173)
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 2021-08-02
